subject: Warm-start timelines, RPO sampling & tabletop coordination for HarborBank
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@harborbank.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14 08:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Info request: warm-start timings and RPO sampling

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the overview on Friday. HarborBank's security team has two narrow asks so we can close the BCP section of our SIG:

1) Warm-start evidence: can you provide the warm-cache snapshot timestamps and the observed token-generation latency for the 3 most recent warm-starts (preferably as logs or a short CSV)? We want to validate the claimed ~120s warm-up to 95% performance.

2) RPO sampling: we need the sampling methodology and the raw RPO measurement logs from the June tabletop (time series for the recovery window). A minimal CSV with timestamps and restore points is fine.

Also, any short excerpt of the runbook that lists the ordered recovery steps (network, KV restore, traffic switch) would be helpful. If you can provide these by EOD Wednesday 2027-07-20 we can complete the control evidence.

One more thing — would you be open to a 30-minute tabletop-clarification call next week so our SOC folks can cross-check assumptions?

Thanks,
Daniel
HarborBank — Cloud Risk & SOC

(Attachment request: warm_cache_snapshot, rpo sampling logs, runbook excerpt)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@harborbank.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Info request: warm-start timings and RPO sampling

Hi Daniel —

We can provide everything you asked for. High-level plan:

- Warm-cache snapshots + latency telemetry: we'll export the last three warm-start sessions (timestamps + 1-min token-latency buckets) as a CSV.
- RPO sampling logs: we'll include the June tabletop restore points and the sampling methodology (how we pick checkpoints, retention windows, and verification runs).
- Runbook excerpt: we'll include the operational steps that map to the SOC control categories (network failover, KV cache reclamation, traffic cutover).

I'll assemble the artifacts and send them from my mailbox by COB Wednesday 2027-07-20. Can you confirm whether HarborBank prefers a signed attestation or if the artifacts alone are sufficient for this control?

Also, yes — a 30-minute call is good. I'm proposing Tuesday 2027-07-21 10:00am PT; does that work?

Best,
Sofia
Site Reliability & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(Internal: looping Ben for the export/packaging; Irene for attestation language)

Team —

HarborBank wants: warm-cache snapshots (last 3 warm-starts), RPO sampling logs from our June tabletop, and a runbook excerpt. Deadline: COB 2027-07-20.

Action items:
- Ben: can you pull the warm-start telemetry (token-latency buckets + timestamps) and produce a CSV with per-minute buckets for the three most recent warm-start events? Prefer the raw log and a 1‑page summary with p95/p99 numbers.
- Markus: do we have a short clip or a transcript from the June tabletop restore that shows the restore points and timings? If we don't have a clip, deliver the restore-point CSV and the sampling methodology note.
- Irene: HarborBank may request a signed attestation. Can you draft a 1-paragraph attestation template that a leader (CTO/Head of Ops) can sign?

Please flag any blockers by EOD 2027-07-16 so we can escalate.

Thanks — Sofia

- warm_cache_snapshot_20270714.json (trimmed to include only vault IDs and cache hit warmup timelines)

Subject: Deliverables: warm-cache evidence + RPO sampling logs (HarborBank)

Daniel —

Per your request, attached are the artifacts for HarborBank's BCP control review:

Attachments included:
- redwood_runbook_failover_excerpt_v2.pdf — the operative runbook excerpt describing ordered recovery steps and cutover decision points.
- warm_cache_snapshot_20270714.json — trimmed warm-cache state captures for the three most recent warm-starts with timestamps and cache hit ramps.
- rpo_sampling_logs_20270713.csv — raw restore-point timeline (timestamp, restore_point_id, bytes_restored, restore_duration_seconds).
- tabletop_summary_20270714.docx — facilitator notes and a short timeline from the June tabletop.

Summary:
- Observed warm-start p95 across sessions: ~120–132s (see CSV). Median ramp to 80% throughput averaged ~70s. These are measured from service process start to stable token generation rate; details and methodology are in the attached sampling CSV and the tabletop doc.
- RPO sampling method: we sample the most recent 5 restore points spaced by retention window, verify checksums post-restore, and record restore duration for each checkpoint. The CSV includes the raw measurements.

Irene has drafted a short attestation template; if HarborBank requires a signed attestation we can provide that by company letterhead within 48 hours.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether artifacts are sufficient or if you need a signed attestation.
- We scheduled a 30-minute call to walk through the artifacts on 2027-07-21 10:00am PT — invite should be in your calendar.

Thanks for the thorough review — happy to clarify any datapoints.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Site Reliability & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: redwood_runbook_failover_excerpt_v2.pdf, warm_cache_snapshot_20270714.json, rpo_sampling_logs_20270713.csv, tabletop_summary_20270714.docx)
